summary: Unexpected drop in billed usage after quantized model rollout; missing invoice credits
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports a sudden and sustained decrease in billed token usage for multiple daily jobs starting 2026-03-09 07:00 UTC after we recommended a quantized model variant. Usage in their dashboard shows ~60% lower token consumption vs expected; invoices show lower charges and the customer is requesting a credit for the under-billed period.

Impact:
- NimbleDocs batch pipelines process document summarization for paying users; lower billed usage appears to correlate with fewer tokens recorded on invoices (customer claims revenue leakage).
- Customer requests audit logs + provisional credit while investigation proceeds.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool in us-west-2, autoscaling enabled, config applied via customer reserved capacity.
- Rollout applied: model variant switch from redwood-mini-v2 -> redwood-mini-v2-quantized-8bit on 2026-03-09 06:40 UTC (canary then full for their org).

Steps to reproduce (as reported by customer):
1) Customer runs daily batch at 06:50 UTC (starts at 06:45–07:10 window).
2) Before rollout, dashboard matched expected token counts and invoiced amounts.
3) After rollout, dashboard shows reduced token counts while generation outputs are functionally equivalent per customer's QA.

Observed behaviour:
- Metering dashboard shows 55–65% less billed tokens for the affected org for all jobs that hit the quantized variant.
- Streaming vs non-streaming aggregation difference visible in internal logs for the org: streaming token metric missing KV-cache prefix accounting.

Expected behaviour:
- Token metering should reflect generated tokens across variants identically (billing-exposed tokens may differ slightly due to quantization tokenization edge cases but not this magnitude).

Request:
- Full audit of metering pipeline for the org between 2026-03-09 and 2026-03-11.
- Provisional invoice credit for underbilled delta if confirmed.
- Root cause and mitigation to prevent future occurrences.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:15 - Aisha Patel (Support): Acknowledged ticket. Reached out to customer for raw job IDs and sample request IDs. SLA first response delivered.
2026-03-10 10:02 - Customer (NimbleDocs Support): Provided representative request IDs and pair of job run IDs: job-nd-20260309-0648, job-nd-20260310-0647. Attached CSV with per-shard token counts.
2026-03-10 13:40 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Noted correlation with quantized rollout. Spun up metering replay for provided request IDs against pre-rollout and post-rollout metric collectors.

2026-03-11 08:12 - Eng (runtime): Initial hypothesis: a prefix/KV-cache accounting change in the quantized path omitted counting cached tokens in the billing aggregation job when streaming was enabled. Investigating aggregator lambda that collapses per-chunk counts.
2026-03-11 15:04 - Billing Ops: If metering gap confirmed, will prepare provisional credit and invoice adjustment template for NimbleDocs; need confirmed delta by EOD 2026-03-12.

2026-03-12 09:45 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Replayed traces show that in the quantized runtime we emit meter.event with token_delta omitted for events that were served from KV cache when streaming hooks were present. Attached trace IDs: trace-8812, trace-8813.

2026-03-12 12:30 - Support: Informed customer that engineering has identified a metering attribution gap and we are preparing a remediation plan. Requested permission to apply provisional credit while fix is rolled out.
investigation_notes: Metering replay: compared raw model responses to billing-aggregator input; found consistent undercount for cached prefixes when streaming=true and model path quantized-8bit.

Root cause hypothesis: runtime emitted metric key 'token_count_stream' only on non-cached generation path; metric ingestion job expects 'token_count' and ignores token_count_stream for billing aggregation due to legacy rename.
Related change: infra PR github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2145 merged 2026-03-09 05:50 UTC adjusted streaming hook identifiers for quantized path (introduced rename regression).

Scope: initial estimate affects dedicated orgs using quantized variants + streaming enabled; estimated impacted window 2026-03-09 06:40 UTC -> 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC (fix rollout started 2026-03-12 09:50 UTC).
Estimated undercount: aggregate replay suggests ~0.58x billed tokens vs real tokens for NimbleDocs during affected runs. Need final delta after full re-ingestion to confirm credits.
resolution: Workaround applied: Billing ops approved provisional credit equal to 80% of the preliminary delta subject to adjustment after full re-ingestion. Engineering patched metric emitter to include 'token_count' for cached streaming path and deployed hotfix to canary 2026-03-12 09:50 UTC and full rollout by 2026-03-12 13:10 UTC. Follow-ups: (1) re-ingest affected range and compute final delta; (2) issue invoice adjustment and credit note to NimbleDocs; (3) add automated regression test for metric name coverage across streaming/cached/quantized paths. Ticket remains open until re-ingestion and invoice adjustment complete.
